body.message:
We would like to inform you that we can offer you the same rate previously provided, valid until 29th September. We hope this will allow you sufficient time to make alternative arrangements and find a new place to stay.

Unfortunately, we are unable to provide a full refund. However, we can check with the management regarding a possible refund for any unused days of the reservation.

Kindly confirm if you would like us to proceed with checking this with the management, and we will update you accordingly.
